title: Hackatime JSON error
description: The body of every JSON error the captured actions send: render_error and the helpers built on it (render_helpers.rb lines 9-29), and the inline errors in authenticated/application_controller.rb lines 20-26. Two refusals send no JSON and have no schema here: the admin API's token check answers 401 with Rails' plain-text 'HTTP Token: Access denied.', and Doorkeeper refuses a bad OAuth token itself.

error.description: A short message. The strings each action sends are listed in endpoints.json.
